title: PowerToys Settings crashes on Windows 10 launch

judgment.rationale: The reported COR_E_EXECUTIONENGINE crash occurs before PowerToys logging, and the reporter says either disabling Hardware-enforced Stack Protection for PowerToys.Settings.exe or installing Windows updates resolves it. Current evidence points to an OS/.NET/CET servicing condition, not a confirmed PowerToys code path.
evidence: Windows 10 only; same action works on Windows 11.
Reporter reports success after Windows updates and an executable mitigation override.
judgment.recommended_action: Request the exact Windows 10 build and confirm behavior after current servicing without the per-program override.

fix_assessment.rationale: A PowerToys source fix is not supportable until current Windows servicing fails to resolve the pre-application runtime crash.

issue_context.summary: Settings crashes before logging on one Windows 10 environment and is reportedly fixed by Windows updates or disabling a CET mitigation.
information_gaps: Exact Windows version/build and cumulative update.
Result after updates with override removed.

actions.label: Request Windows servicing details

comment.body: Please provide the exact Windows 10 version/build from winver and cumulative-update level. After installing all applicable updates and rebooting, remove the per-program Hardware-enforced Stack Protection override for PowerToys.Settings.exe and report whether Settings still crashes from the PowerToys icon.
